WELCOME TO MAIDENHEAD CHIROPRACTIC CLINIC

At Maidenhead Chiropractic Clinic, we offer a multidisciplinary approach to your health.  We offer a range of private complimentary health services to suit any needs, all under one roof. 

Our services include; Chiropractic, Massage and Myofascial Release therapy, Scar Therapy and Sports Therapy. Our highly trained team can help you decide which service may be better for you, if you are unsure to achieve the best possible results for you.

Our Clinic is situated within the beautiful Castle Royle Golf & Country Club, Knowl Hill making is easily accessible to those in Maidenhead, Burchetts Green, Littlewick Green, Henley, Marlow, Wargrave, Twyford and Sonning.
